uncited: This family focuses on low-level execution characteristics (warps, registers, cache lines) rather than mathematical traversal logic, distinguishing it from algorithmic variants like [Parallel 3D-DDA](6247-parallel-3d-dda.md) and [GPU Screen-Space Ray Tracing via DDA](10121-gpu-screen-space-ray-tracing-via-dda.md).
**Occupancy Management:** Shader occupancy is critical; high register allocation and excessive state carried across loops reduce concurrent warps and cause memory stalls.
